status: Ready for root integration; completed exact-source audit
mechanism: Count three classes of solid 2x2,3x3,4x4 squares; discard noise; nest one remaining square per size in each stack. Demonstrations select both output orientation and either all-counts stacking or atlas cap min(max count, twice count of largest squares).
hypothesis_scope: Explicit competing simple mechanisms, not proof that cap is intended. Canonical first two demonstrations identify cap; native fresh examples ordinarily identify all. Unresolved query disagreement abstains. No fitted isolation-gap rule.
background_identifiability: Do not assume majority. Enumerate square-size colour roles, then background/noise roles satisfying native noise prohibition on 2x2 monochromatic blocks. Require unique visible assignment. Dense noise with a visible background block succeeds even when background is minority. Same-input/different-output native twins with both remaining hues lacking 2x2 blocks are saved and rejected.
independence: Direct program extracts same-colour connected components, then enumerates size-colour roles. Gate identifies maximal solid blocks by row runs and area accounting, then enumerates background/noise first. Source paints largest-to-smallest squares; gate computes minimum covering square at each output cell.
constructor_status: No active or proposed constructor changes; both canonical labels and random native distribution preserved.
query_fixed_curriculum: If demo hypotheses disagree on a sampled query, only demonstration context is resampled. The hard query is retained. Intrinsically ambiguous role input is rejected, never solved using query labels.
tests: test_square_cursor_hypotheses.py: canonical fixtures, poisoned query answers, explicit all/cap disagreement and abstention, odd/always disagreement, D4 factory independence, missing/bad demonstrations, minority-background success, identical-input latent-role twins.
sampler_caveat: 24 native generator calls exceeded the 3-second deadline. These are explicitly recorded; no constructor or parameter bounds were changed. 1000 unique accepted pairs were checked. Native unbounded random placement can be slow at dense counts; consider separate placement optimization preserving support, not reduced counts.
